text: Now the second feature, on the website. Insights. Pick a company, drug, or condition, and get one view across every agency.
Two modes. Update, for what's new since your last visit. Research, for what matters, including landmark trials from years back.
One click builds it, live from ClinicalTrials.gov, the F.D.A., and S.E.C. EDGAR.
In seconds: key stats, the high-signal events, and the terms rising right now.
There's no LLM in the core, so there's nothing to hallucinate. Every figure is counted from the cited records underneath, and a daily check runs every tool against the live government APIs.
Emerging themes, the busiest sponsors, the phase mix, a ranked view of what actually matters.
It runs in your browser. No login, no tracking. That's OpenBioNews.
